# PRISMATA - ARCHITECTURAL PLANNING DOCUMENT

Last canonicalized: 2026-07-23 (see `archive/plan-documents/checklists/2026-07-23-plan-prismata-architecture.checklist.md`)

This checklist captures planning stages and next actions for the Universe schema editor and ASTalyzer.

## PLANNING STAGES

PHASE 1 — CANONICAL FOUNDATIONS (COMPLETE)
- UDI Standard (v0.1.0)
- Canonical Schema Directory (Meta/canonical)
- UDI Validator Spec
- Deterministic UDI Pattern + Segments
- Cross-document uniqueness rules

PHASE 2 — CORE ANALYSIS LAYER (COMPLETE)
- ASTalyzer (Python AST)
- ASTalyzer Menu
- OS-dependent load/save dialogs
- Interface primitives (file/folder pickers)
- Deterministic AST output

PHASE 3 — APPLICATION LAYER (IN PROGRESS)
- Universe basic menu
- Universe schema viewer
- Universe schema loader
- Universe integration with canonical schemas
- TODO: Universe editing verbs, validation pipeline, save pipeline

PHASE 4 — VALIDATION & SELF-MAINTENANCE (BEGINNING)
- TODO: Universe + ASTalyzer integration loop, schema mutation → validation → save → re-validate

PHASE 5 — AWARENESS & DOCUMENTATION (NOT STARTED)
- TODO: ASTalyzer TS support, unified AST, human-readable summaries

## NEXT THREE HIGH-LEVERAGE STEPS
1. Add Universe editing verbs (create/update/delete/rename/move/validate/diff)
2. Add ASTalyzer TypeScript support (ts-morph / tsc)
3. Add ASTalyzer human-readable summaries and Universe preview integration

## HISTORY
- 2026-07-23: Canonicalized from dated snapshot (see archive)
